item.title: I gave an AI agent an old laptop board and a Discord server
item.description: My first try at a personal AI agent on a Raspberry Pi was more hassle than it was worth. My second, Hermes on a spare Framework mainboard, now runs my lights, music, plants, newsletter and a lot of my day. Here's how it's set up, what it saves me, and the rules I keep it on.
